diagnosticHistory: Mac create v1 queried an identifier not exposed by the sidebar and was interrupted; no task was created

Mac create v2 created the task but inserted a Tab into notes; v3 resumed that same unsynced draft offline, corrected notes natively and verified normal Quit. This is combined creation evidence, not a fresh v3 Add Task run
Phone receipt v1 received the correct cache but the project was below the Browse viewport; corrected driver scrolls to it

Phone receipt v2/v3 failed secure keyboard paste; v4 was interrupted after sampling a blocked UIPasteboard.items call in the runner. The final driver types into the secure field and does not access the clipboard

Phone receipt v5 machine-passed, but its inspected relaunch screenshot showed sign-in because the driver retained live-auth-ui-test. v5 is explicitly rejected as relaunch acceptance; corrected v6 asserts signed-in workspace and reopens the actual task
Cleanup v1 consequently failed before finalizing and was interrupted. Only synthetic copies were restored again through native Mac UI; cleanup v2 is the accepted receipt
